text:
clare: Heads-up: the quickstart vector-index demo is double-charging test runs. Sampleapp calls `sdk.embeddings.create_batch({ inputs: texts })` but the REST API expects `input` (singular) or `input[]` depending on client.

ben: Do we have the request shape and error?

clare: The server logs show two create calls for the same job id when network flaked and SDK retried: `Embedding request received: count=10 request_id=rid_abc` then later `Embedding request received: count=10 request_id=rid_def`. We saw 2x token billing.

anoop: Hmm. Two issues here: param naming mismatch (SDK uses `inputs` array while server accepts `input` array) can cause middleware to treat it as non-idempotent or to reformat; and the retry layer retries the whole body without idempotency keys.

melissa: Quickstart README uses the REST curl that sets `Idempotency-Key: $IDEMP` for embeddings. SDK doesn't accept idempotency for embeddings and also changed param name in v2.4 without docs update. That's bad.

ben: Can you paste the sampleapp snippet?

clare: Sure:```js
// quickstart indexing
const res = await sdk.embeddings.create_batch({ inputs: docs.map(d=>d.text) })
indexer.addMany(res.data)
```

nanoop: Solution proposal: 1) SDK should accept both `input` and `inputs` in the public surface (map both to the canonical `input` array when serializing). 2) Add optional `idempotency_key` param for embeddings.create_batch and ensure retry middleware reuses it on retries. 3) Update SDK docs and quickstart examples to show idempotency usage for batch endpoints that are billable.

melissa: Also add an integration test: simulate transient network 502 on first attempt, ensure SDK retries with same idempotency key and server dedupes, and assert billing only once.

clare: I'll patch the quickstart to add a REST fallback that generates an idempotency key and posts directly, to stop bleeding credits while SDK fix lands. Snippet I'm using:```js
const idemp = crypto.randomUUID()
await fetch(`${API_BASE}/v1/embeddings/batch`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'Idempotency-Key': idemp, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: docs.map(d=>d.text) })
})
```

ben: I'll implement the SDK mapping and idempotency support. Plan: keep existing `create_batch(inputs=...)` call for backwards compat but accept `input` alias; add optional `idempotency_key` in method signature and plumb to headers; update retry middleware to only auto-retry batch endpoints if idempotency_key is present.

nanoop: Please add a changelog note and an alert to billing team for possible customer-impacting double-charge windows so we can reconcile.

devex-bot: Created issue #621: "Node SDK embeddings.create_batch: accept input/inputs + idempotency_key; safe retry behavior" assigned to @ben. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/621 :ledger:

melissa: Thanks. Will deploy the sampleapp REST fallback and update quickstart docs to call out idempotency. Also adding a CI job that runs the indexing sample under induced 502s to catch regressions.

ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/712 implementing aliases + idempotency + tests. Requesting review from @nanoop and @melissa.
